text:
Marta: Quick heads-up — final on-site for Sr Infra Eng tomorrow 3pm PT. Panel = @Liam @Devon @Jess + me. Liam flagged an on-call conflict, might need a debrief swap.

Liam: Can't do debrief — oncall escalation possible. I can still interview but won't be available for post-score discussion.

Jess: I can take debrief. Quick rubric Q: do we want System Design / Reliability / Collaboration = 50/30/20 or tilt to reliability?

Devon: Hiring manager (Aly) asked for a reliability tilt earlier. My suggestion 55/30/15. Open to discussion.

Marta: Aly prefers reliability tilt but still cares about architecture. OK let's use 55/30/15. I'll update the rubric: https://redwood-internal/docs/hiring/rubrics/sr-infra

Recruiter-Bot: Reminder — consent to record required. Please confirm with candidate before starting. (automated)

Liam: I'll put quick scoring anchors in the tracker: +2 Strong hire, +1 Hire, 0 Borderline, -1 Reject. Will add comments in /hiring/tracker.

Jess: Taking debrief. I'll be available for 30m at 4:15pm PT (ETA after meeting). @Marta can you add me to the hangout & calendar? Also please paste the system design prompt below so all panelists use the same brief.

Marta: Done — you have edit on rubric and calendar invite. Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=xyz. Consent checkbox ticked.

Devon: System design prompt (use for all panelists):
```
Design a backend for a global key-value store with multilocation failover. Outline data model, consistency, failure modes and scaling plan.
```

Jess: Copy. I'll use those anchors during scoring and capture notes in the candidate doc. :thumbsup: 

Liam: Thanks team. If anything changes ping here or DM. -L
